description: An expression statement with no effect at a body top (`@count`, `@count == 1`) is E-STMT-NO-EFFECT, one per statement; the declaration between them survives.
rationale: Ruling user-voice-scrml.md S445 item 2: "Any expression statement with no effect is an error. An effect means a call, an assignment, `++`/`--`, or a `send`. Bare `@count` becomes an error too, which replaces the `@count` example in S441 (3)."
